name: API: Deep Lookup Prompts
description:
### Detailed/Technical:

Triggers a Slack Block Kit notification upon a Deep Lookup completion event. The message includes:

**Lookup Summary:** Title, user, matched results count, match rate percentage, total runs, PLG mode, test mode indicator

**Cost & Status:** Lookup cost and completion status

**Customer Context:** Customer ID, customer status, company email, triggered by, account created date, customer start date, customer paid status, customer onboarded status, lead owner, lead status, signup page, request ID, run ID

**Search Details:** Original search prompt, enriched fields, applied constraints

**Performance Metrics:** Max results, total results, matched results, pages read, pages considered, records enriched, cells enriched, fields generated

**Usage & Metadata:** Event type, free run indicator, timestamp, AI token usage (input/output tokens)

**Quick Actions:** Button linking to Deep Lookup details page in CP

Designed to give Sales/CS instant visibility into Deep Lookup usage, performance, and customer engagement.
